title: Jehozabad
summary: Jehovah-given. (1.) The son of Obed-edom (1 Chr. 26:4), one of the Levite porters.

inlines.v: Jehovah-given. (1.) The son of Obed-edom (1 Chr. 26:4), one of the Levite porters.
(2.) The son of Shomer, one of the two conspirators who put king Jehoash to death in Millo in Jerusalem (2 Kings 12:21).
